stage: offline model checks; browser, independent and integration review are separate

informationSetInvariant.claim: No fitted window contains an observation dated later than its own origin.
routes: feature causality, against each training row’s OWN origin minus the reporting delay
label maturity, against the FIT’s origin
closure of the whole fit, asserted separately because it is the claim a reader checks against a drawing
informationSetInvariant.auditFalsified: A deliberately invalid fit is constructed above and all three violation kinds are asserted to fire, because an audit that always returns clean is not an audit.

wholeGridSweeps.eligibility: 112 cutoff/horizon/delay combinations over 7 offered origins, by an availability-SET route that never writes the inequality
wholeGridSweeps.eligibilityGrading: 112 grid points, each graded correct, missing-one and extra-one
wholeGridSweeps.realRequests: 108 origin and season-length combinations on the served series
wholeGridSweeps.baselineRules: 282 history/season/horizon combinations against a cycle-materialisation route

independentRoutes.seasonal: the final observed cycle materialised and walked round, never the index formula
independentRoutes.eligibility: availability as a SET of observations known at each day, never s + h + d <= cutoff
independentRoutes.splitSchedules: the calendar simulated forward day by day, never the module’s own generator
independentRoutes.realResults: recomputed from the served CSV, parsed in this process
independentRoutes.manuscript: the values typed in the frozen manuscript, compared against both the packet JSON and the recomputation

degenerateInputsExercised: a horizon with no supplied outcome: unscored, with the denominator printed, never zero
no scored horizon at all: the mean is null rather than zero
an exactly zero error, kept distinguishable from no score
an empty eligible set, reachable and graded correct when predicted
a season length of one, which IS the naive rule, so the comparison must return an exact tie
a falling history where every drift prediction is clipped at zero
a three-way tie in the winner logic
a correct set given out of order and with repeats
limitations: These are offline model checks. Nothing here establishes that the rendered page looks right, that a label is legible, or that a control is reachable by keyboard; that is the browser verifier.
The ridge predictions are re-derived in scripts/verify-timeseries-data.py, not here: this process does not fit models. What is checked here is the SCHEDULE those fits run under.
The floors are set far below the current totals, so they catch a wholesale loss of checking rather than the removal of one assertion.
